hazards_summary.name: Rising acid
functions: sources/ssb-decomp-re/src/gr/grcommon/grzebes.c: grZebesMakeAcid, grZebesProcUpdate, grZebesAcidUpdateNormal/Shake/Rise, grZebesAcidSetLevelStep, grZebesAcidSetRandomWait, grZebesAcidCheckGetDamageKind
hazards_summary.summary: Acid root y (code) starts at dGRZebesAcidAttributes[15].acid_level = -3000. Status Wait until GO, then Normal: wait = acid_wait_base + random_min + rand(random_max - random_min) ticks; Shake 18 ticks (quake every 18); Rise 240 ticks with step = ((acid_level[id] + rand_float*250) - curr)/240, then id = (id+1) % 16. Damage when fighter.y < root.y + child.y (child = acid surface DObj, its y bob comes from the AcidAnimJoint table in StageZebesFile3, baked in hazard_data.acid_dobjs).
